fullDescription: A high-fidelity futuristic and cyberpunk-inspired design system optimized for high-end digital fashion, tech laboratories, or NFT marketplaces. Featuring a deep dark mode (#050505) punctuated by vibrant neon cyan, pink, and purple accents. The layout utilizes massive editorial typography (Archivo) paired with sleek geometric sans-serif (Manrope). Key elements include WebGL particle backgrounds, glassmorphism UI components, interactive 3D-simulated product grids, and smooth scroll-triggered reveal animations. Ideal for brands targeting the 'digital vanguard' through high-performance aesthetics and tech-forward interfaces.

structured.summary: A futuristic dark-themed interface centered around a 3D WebGL particle environment. It features massive, bold typography, glassmorphism buttons, and neon-glowing interactive elements that create a 'hacker-chic' or 'lab-status' aesthetic for premium streetwear and tech brands.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Tech-Noir' aesthetic. Typography pairings: 'Archivo' (Black weight, tracking-tighter) for massive headings and 'Manrope' (Light weight) for technical body copy. Colors: Background #050505, Accents #00f3ff (Cyan), #ff00c1 (Pink), #9d00ff (Purple). Visuals include thin 1px borders (rgba 255, 255, 255, 0.1), 12px backdrop blurs, and neon glow shadows. Animations utilize smooth cubic-bezier transitions and constant WebGL particle motion.
style.prompt: Create a design with a core background of #050505. Use 'Archivo' font for headings (900 weight, tracking-tighter) and 'Manrope' for body (300-400 weight). Primary accent color is Neon Cyan (#00f3ff) for active states and icons. Use Neon Pink (#ff00c1) and Neon Purple (#9d00ff) for secondary highlights. Implement glassmorphism using `background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` and a `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)` border. All buttons should have a `border-radius: 9999px`. For product cards, use `border-radius: 40px`. Interactive elements should feature a transition duration of 500ms-700ms with a hover glow effect: `box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.2)`. Background must include a Three.js particle field with 3500 points (color: #00f3ff, size: 0.005) that follows mouse movements smoothly.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling layout with fixed navigation and layered z-index sections. It moves from high-impact hero visuals to technical product grids, ending with a generative lab teaser and a detailed multi-column footer.

prompts.prompt: Fixed top bar, transparent background, px-8 py-6. Left: Logo with a #00f3ff 'zap' icon inside a 40x40px glass box. Center: Hidden on mobile, uppercase tracking-widest links (14px) with #00f3ff underline hover effect. Right: A 'Menu' pill button using glassmorphism styling.

Minimum height 80vh. Featured element: 'Next-Gen' status badge (pill-shaped, #00f3ff/10 bg, pulsating dot). Main heading: Archivo Black, 10vw size, 'BEYOND PROTOCOL' or similar, using a subtle gradient from white to white/20. CTA Group: Primary white pill button with black text, secondary glass pill button with white border.

Infinite horizontal marquee section. Large (5xl) Archivo Black text with extremely low opacity (white/5) or outline-only style. Content should feature technical phrases like 'Cyber-Knit System' or 'Neural-Fit Tech'.

Grid layout (1 col mobile, 3 col desktop) with 32px gap. Each card: 40px border-radius, #0a0a0a inner background. Top section is 4:5 aspect ratio with a subtle bottom-to-top dark gradient. Center features a large icon (e.g., shirt, layers) that scales up and changes color to neon on hover. Bottom section: Glassmorphism bar containing technical pricing (e.g., ETH values) and a circular 'plus' button that inverts colors on hover.

Full-width section with a 60px rounded glass container. Left: 7xl Archivo heading and technical description. Right: A large-scale animated 'generative' graphic consisting of three concentric dashed-line circles spinning at different speeds with a pulsating 3D box icon in the center.

4-column grid. Col 1: Brand logo, brief mission statement, and social icons in 40px circular borders. Col 2: 'Protocol' links with light gray font. Col 3: 'Frequency' newsletter signup with a full-width pill-shaped input field (#ffffff/5 bg) and an arrow-circle submit button. Bottom row: 10px uppercase copyright text with extra-wide (0.3em) tracking.

special_ui_components.description: A small indicator showing system activity.
special_ui_components.prompt: A pill-shaped container with `background: rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.1)`, `border: 1px solid rgba(0, 243, 255, 0.3)`. Inside, a 8px solid #00f3ff circle with an infinite pulse animation and 10px uppercase tracking text.

special_ui_components.description: Large radius card with dynamic hover borders.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container with `border-radius: 40px`, `background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)`. On hover, the border color transitions from `white/5` to a specific neon color (#00f3ff, #9d00ff, or #ff00c1) over 500ms. The internal icon should scale by 1.1x and rotate slightly (e.g., -10deg to 0deg) simultaneously.
